articles.title: 55-year-old Rajasthan ex-serviceman with 138 degrees earns latest from IGNOU
articles.summary: Dashrath Singh, an ex-serviceman from Rajasthan, has achieved an extraordinary feat by accumulating 138 degrees, diplomas, and certificates. This remarkable dedication to continuous learning, far exceeding typical academic pursuits, exemplifies incredible perseverance and intellectual curiosity. His inspiring journey serves as a powerful testament to lifelong personal development and commitment, qualities highly valued for SSB aspirants aiming for excellence in all spheres.
